channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Debate deve ser visto por 100 milhões de eleitores, projeta instituto de pesquisa
item.description: An Ipespe/Abrapel survey projects that 100 million voters may watch the debate between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Lula (PT) scheduled for tonight on Globo. Seven out of ten Brazilians say they will definitely watch the showdown.

item.title: Janones fará live e não irá à Globo para o debate, diz campanha de Lula
item.description: Lula's campaign states André Janones will not attend the Globo debate, choosing a live stream instead. The debate will be between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Cleitinho confirma presença no ato de Flávio Bolsonaro em BH neste sábado
item.description: Minas Gerais' elected governor Cleitinho Azevedo ( Republicans) confirmed his attendance at Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) event in Belo Horizonte this Saturday (October 24th), at Praça da Liberdade. This marks the first joint public appearance between the two allies in Minas during the election campaign, following the first round which nominated a competing candidate to PL. The event will feature other pro-Bolsonaro politicians including Nikolas Ferreira and Domingos Sávio.

item.title: Flávio viaja ao Rio para debate depois de reunião com Tarcísio
item.description: Presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) traveled to Rio de Janeiro to participate in a debate organized by Globo after meeting with São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas, with whom he defined strategies for the televised contest.

item.title: Secretário é afastado após defender prisão de eleitores do PT no MA
item.description: The municipal security secretary of Barra do Corda (MA), Sargento James Mota da Silva, was removed after audio recordings surfaced in which he advocates imprisoning PT supporters to intimidate voters. Mayor Rigo Teles (MDB) ordered his removal and the TSE-MA requested a federal police investigation into the statements threatening voting freedom.

item.title: Sem citar ‘Exército do Lula’, TSE diz que não determinou derrubada de canal de WhatsApp
item.description: The TSE stated it did not order the removal of any WhatsApp channels, including 'Exército do Lula', distancing itself from claims of pressure on Meta and other platforms. The court requested information from companies regarding the channel following a lawsuit filed by Flávio Bolsonaro's legal team, with a 24-hour deadline. A meeting was held with platform representatives to discuss measures until the second-round election.

item.title: Marçal não vai ao debate da Globo, mas vai ao Rio...
item.description: Pablo Marçal travels to Rio de Janeiro but skips the Globo debate, while Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign promotes the slogan 'Less Marçal and more Tarcísio'. The strategy aims to shift focus away from the PTB candidate toward the Rio governor.

item.title: “Flávio vai triturar o Brasil”, diz Lula
item.description: Lula claims Flávio Bolsonaro will 'trample Brazil' and threatens social gains with proposed R$250 billion budget cuts. The ad highlights areas like wages, pensions and social programs, while Flávio denies cutting social benefits.

item.title: Áudio: Eleitores voltam às urnas no domingo para definir o próximo presidente
item.description: The presidential election runoff will be decided between Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) and President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), securing 47.03% and 45.16% of valid votes in the first round. The Electoral Court aims to reduce abstention, which reached 21.08% in the first phase.

item.title: Bap negociou com Flávio Bolsonaro sobre fim de bets em meio às semifinais do Flamengo na Libertadores
item.description: Flamengo president Luiz Eduardo Baptista (Bap) reportedly negotiated with PL presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro to end the ban on sports betting (bets) in Brazil, during the Libertadores semifinals. Fans protested against the provisional measure maintaining the ban, and with the team eliminated, the club faces financial impacts for 2027.

item.title: “Na urna, você é o dono do seu destino”, diz Flávio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro released final campaign ads featuring supporters and the message 'on election day, you are the owner of your destiny'. Polling data shows him tied or leading in 15 of 17 national surveys.

item.title: TSE manda remover 26 posts com fake news contra Alfredo Gaspar
item.description: TSE auxiliary minister Estela Aranha ordered the removal of 26 social media posts accusing Alfredo Gaspar de Mendonça Neto, the running mate of Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), of rape. The preliminary injunction sets a three-hour deadline for the posts' removal.

item.title: TSE manda borrar foto de aliada de Flávio em propaganda de Lula
item.description: The TSE ordered Lula's campaign to air ads with Val Meliga's image blurred, following her right-of-response plea against being associated with criticisms of Flávio Bolsonaro. The ruling partially favored her, maintaining the blur by 6-1, while Minister Estela Aranha deemed the voluntary removal sufficient. Val Meliga, former PSL treasurer, argued that the broadcast harmed her honor by implying she belonged to the political group criticized by Lula.

item.title: Garotinho é impedido de votar no segundo turno após decisão do TRE-RJ
item.description: Former governor Anthony Garotinho had his candidacy rejected for the second round of the 2026 elections by the Rio de Janeiro Electoral Court following a decision by the Supreme Electoral Court, which upheld his ineligibility due to lack of full exercise of political rights. The suspension stems from a conviction for administrative misconduct in the Saúde em Movimento program, between 2005 and 2006. Garotinho stated he will appeal the decision.

item.title: Pode levar colinha nas eleições 2026? Veja o que diz o TSE e como organizar seus votos
item.description: Voters may use paper notes with candidate numbers at the polling station, as recommended by the TSE, but electronic devices such as cell phones are strictly prohibited. In the runoff, over 158 million Brazilians will vote for president and, in seven states, also for governor. Notes should be organized following the order displayed on the electronic ballot box.

item.title: ‘Flávio quer discutir grandes problemas do país’, diz Tarcísio de Freitas sobre debate
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas will be present at the presidential debate on Rede Globo and states that Flávio Bolsonaro is ready to tackle the country's major issues. Tarcísio has been increasing his influence in Flávio's campaign, helping refine his strategy to win undecided voters in the final stretch. After the debate, the governor plans to vote in São Paulo and travel to Brasília to follow the election results alongside Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: TSE nega ordem para retirar canais do WhatsApp e critica “ilações”
item.description: The TSE clarified that it did not order the removal of WhatsApp channels, dismissing 'inferences' about alleged determinations. The court met with representatives of digital platforms to discuss compliance with electoral legislation, following investigations into the 'Exército do Lula' channel, administered by André Janones. Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign questioned coordinated support activities through the channel, which would have directed followers to perform specific Google searches.

item.title: Domingo é dia de votar: eleitores voltam às urnas para escolher presidente
item.description: In the 2026 presidential runoff, Brazilian voters choose between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) for president. Voting takes place from 8am to 5pm, with adjusted times in certain regions, and is mandatory for voters aged 18 to 70. Some states also hold gubernatorial runoffs.

item.title: Brasileiros dominam primeira fase e são favoritos na Libertadores Feminina
item.description: Three Brazilian teams dominated the group stage of the 2026 Women's Libertadores, securing quarterfinal berths without suffering defeats. Corinthians and Cruzeiro finished with a 100% record, while Palmeiras claimed group leadership with seven points. The collective performance reinforces the strength of Brazilian women's football on the continent.

item.title: Após decisão de Mendonça, campanhas de Flávio e Lula entregam novos documentos e seguem sem abrir os sigilos
item.description: Following Minister André Mendonça's ruling, Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula submitted new documents to the TSE but did not release their data. Lula's team seeks TSE mediation to publish data simultaneously, while Flávio's camp agrees with the decision but has not opened its own records and asks Lula to disclose first.

item.title: Nunes Marques aguarda resposta da Meta sobre 'Exército do Lula' e indica que pode retirar canal do ar se houver irregularidade
item.description: The TSE president, Kassio Nunes Marques, is awaiting Meta's response regarding the 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel to decide on its suspension. He ordered Meta, Google, and X to submit technical reports within 24 hours about alleged coordinated activity on social media. Suspension will depend on identifying electoral irregularities.

item.title: TSE diz que não determinou suspensão de canais de WhatsApp e cobra atuação isonômica de plataformas
item.description: TSE president Nunes Marques called for equal treatment by digital platforms in the second round and clarified that no WhatsApp channels were suspended, requesting information on alleged coordinated activity in the 'Exército do Lula' channel.

item.title: Zona Sul distribui carta aos funcionários em defesa do 'voto consciente' e necessidade de 'mudar'
item.description: The Zona Sul supermarket chain distributed a letter to its employees before the 2026 election, advocating for 'change' and criticizing Brazil's 'ethical, moral, and model exhaustion.' Although it does not explicitly name any candidate, the document signed by the company's president highlights institutional challenges and calls for value and trust recovery. The initiative reflects corporate positioning on national crisis without endorsing any candidate.

item.title: Madonna apoia Lula à reeleição em post no Instagram
item.description: American singer Madonna and British musician Roger Waters publicly expressed support for Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) re-election on social media, emphasizing defense of democracy, indigenous peoples, and the Amazon. Other international artists, such as The Strokes, also engaged in the race between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), reflecting cultural influence over the 2026 Brazilian elections.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro fala em Deus e exibe Pai Nosso em último programa na TV
item.description: In his final TV advertisement, Flávio Bolsonaro appealed to religious voters by displaying a collective Lord's Prayer for 30 seconds and emphasizing unity between evangelicals and Catholics. The ad concluded with a religious message, reinforcing his positioning. According to Datafolha, Bolsonaro leads among evangelicals (69% to 26%) while Lula leads among Catholics (55% to 39%).

item.title: Farmacêuticas se opõem à proposta da EMS de elevar imposto de canetas emagrecedoras importadas
item.description: EMS proposed increasing import taxes on weight-loss pens from 7.2% to 15%, facing strong opposition from the pharmaceutical industry and sectoral entities. Critics argue the measure harms competition and reduces drug supply in Brazil. EMS claims to have invested over R$1 billion in domestic production of similar medications.

item.title: Ipespe/Abrapel: Flávio Bolsonaro tem 50,5% dos votos válidos no 2º turno, e Lula, 49,5%
item.description: A poll by Ipespe/Abrapel released on October 23, 2026 shows Flávio Bolsonaro leading with 50.5% of valid votes against Lula's 49.5% in the runoff. The poll excludes blank, null, and undecided votes.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro tem 52% dos votos válidos, ante 48% de Lula, diz Alfa Inteligência
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro leads the Alfa Inteligência poll with 52% of valid votes against Lula's 48% in the runoff. The advantage is within the margin of error, remaining stable compared to the previous survey.

item.title: TSE dá 24 horas para Meta e X explicarem distribuição de conteúdos políticos
item.description: The TSE demanded that Meta and X explain within 24 hours their rules for distributing political content, advertising, content removal, and AI use, as ordered by the chief election officer, Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva.

item.title: Uma campanha eleitoral em que faltou discutir tudo, da economia à democracia
item.description: The 2026 election campaign concludes with a significant lack of substantive debates on key issues such as economy, health, education, and democracy. The first round was dominated by discussions about the Supreme Court, while the second round still lacked depth in policy proposals. The Globo debate represents the final attempt at ideological confrontation before the elections.

item.title: MC Cabelinho critica Flávio: “Nunca fez besteira sem ter o pai pra limpar”
item.description: MC Cabelinho released a YouTube video criticizing Flávio Bolsonaro, questioning his political rise and R$8 million in assets, emphasizing that the senator benefited from family privileges. The singer also attacked Flávio's meritocracy discourse. Neymar responded to the criticisms by commenting on the artist's post.

item.title: Madonna compartilha post que defende voto em Lula: 'Pela democracia'
item.description: Pop star Madonna endorsed Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) for the Brazilian presidential runoff, highlighting democracy, Amazon protection, and education. Other artists like Roger Waters voiced support for Lula while criticizing Flávio Bolsonaro (PL).

item.title: Flávio propõe retomada de privatizações; Lula quer fortalecer empresas
item.description: In the Brazilian runoff election, Flávio Bolsonaro and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva present opposing government programs on the role of the state and privatizations. Lula defends strengthening public companies like Petrobras and Correios, focusing on transparency, anti-corruption efforts, and universal digital public services. Flávio proposes resuming privatizations to reduce public deficits and modernize the state apparatus.

item.title: O risco de Flávio agir como ‘playboy da Barra’ para enfrentar Lula em novo debate
item.description: The debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro featured heated exchanges, including corruption accusations and criticism over pandemic vaccine management. Flávio took an aggressive stance, comparing Lula to someone 'vaccinated,' which triggered negative reactions. The encounter underscored rising tensions ahead of the 2026 presidential race.

item.title: Amorim diz que Trump respeitará resultado das eleições se Lula vencer, apesar de preferência por Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Special advisor Celso Amorim stated that Donald Trump will respect the Brazilian election results if Lula wins, despite preferring Flávio Bolsonaro. Amorim emphasized institutional relationship between Trump and Lula but criticized Meta's interference on social media as grave. He avoided directly accusing the White House but warned about big tech companies' influence on Brazilian foreign policy.

item.title: TSE dá 24 horas para Meta e X explicarem tratamento das candidaturas de Flávio e Lula nas redes
item.description: The TSE has given Meta and X 24 hours to explain how they handled the online presence of Flávio Bolsonaro and Luiz Inácio Lula on social media, following allegations of indirect favoritism through algorithms and AI tools. Lula's coalition claims economic power abuse and misuse of communication channels, while the electoral rapporteur emphasizes that the investigation aims to verify irregularities, without confirming the validity of the accusations. Flávio Bolsonaro and his running mate must also respond within five days, facing a daily fine of R$500,000 if they fail to comply.

item.title: Como Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro chegam ao último debate das eleições
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro prepare for the final presidential debate on TV Globo, adjusting strategies after a confrontational showdown on Band. Lula focuses on proposals and controlling reactions; Flávio aims to reduce direct attacks and clarify his positions. The debate takes place at 21:20 this Friday before Sunday's vote.

item.title: Como será o debate entre Flávio e Lula na Globo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Lula (PT) debate on TV Globo this Friday, 23rd, at 9:20 PM BRT, following the national news, in a forum moderated by César Tralli. It is the last presidential debate before the runoff on October 25th.

item.title: Áudio: TSE oferece assistente virtual aos tribunais regionais para orientar eleitores
item.description: The TSE launched ChatVote, an AI-powered virtual assistant to answer electoral service questions, available on the TSE portal and the e-Título app. The tool allows voters to check information such as polling station location, voting justification, biometrics, and electoral calendar, and can be integrated into the regional courts' websites.

item.title: Irmã de Zambelli declara voto em Lula
item.description: Paula Zambelli Salgado Brasil, sister of former lawmaker Carla Zambelli, declared her vote for Lula in the runoff, emphasizing support for democracy, the Constitution, and the rule of law, contrasting her stance with her family's alignment with the PL party.

item.title: Ministro do TSE manda Meta revisar retirada de vídeo de MC Cabelinho contra Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: TSE minister Ricardo Villas Boas Cueva ordered Meta to review the removal of an MC Cabelinho video criticizing Flávio Bolsonaro, suspecting AI bias. Lula's campaign requested an investigation into alleged unequal platform treatment, while Meta defended the takedown based on electoral rules for AI-generated content in the runoff.

item.title: Corregedor do TSE manda Meta e X explicarem tratamentos a candidaturas
item.description: The electoral court clerk ordered Meta and X to provide technical clarifications on content treatment involving candidate campaigns, including distribution and post removal, in an electoral lawsuit filed by Lula's campaign against Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Eliminação do Flamengo na Libertadores bate recorde de renda no Brasil
item.description: The match between Flamengo and Estudiantes in the Libertadores semifinal generated R$13,149,278, setting the highest revenue record for a single football match in Brazil in 2026. Played at Maracanã Stadium, the game ended with Flamengo's elimination on penalties after a goalless draw. The Rio de Janeiro club leads 8 of the top 10 revenues in Brazilian football this year.

item.title: Bella Campos apoia post de MC Cabelinho sobre eleições e anima fãs do ex-casal: 'Cura'
item.description: Bella Campos shared stories supporting MC Cabelinho during a post about elections, delighting fans of the former couple. The actress referenced the song 'Minha cura' and sparked humorous and emotional reactions from followers.

item.title: Trump respeitará eleição no Brasil, mesmo se Lula for eleito, diz Amorim
item.description: Celso Amorim states that Donald Trump will respect the outcome of the Brazilian elections, even if Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva wins the runoff. He notes that Trump already wished him luck, though he has preferences. Amorim also criticizes Meta's interference in the elections, deeming it serious.

item.title: Flávio reúne sertanejos no programa eleitoral e critica governo por dívidas das famílias, e Lula usa Janones e ataca rival sobre programas sociais
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro closes his campaign with support from country music artists, criticism of the Lula government, and a call to vote, emphasizing economy and security. Lula uses the final broadcast to attack his rival and highlight social programs, ending with a farewell and urging turnout until Sunday.

item.title: Do segundo turno ao dia seguinte: as estratégias das campanhas e os desafios de quem vencer
item.description: The campaigns of Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) adopt different strategies in the second round: Lula focuses on street mobilization and social media to expand his appeal, while Flávio maintains a cautious approach to minimize risks. Both face post-election challenges, particularly in the economic realm, with fiscal adjustments and policy prioritization.

item.title: TSE cobra Meta e X a explicarem uso de IA e alegação da campanha de Lula de benefício a Flávio nas redes
item.description: The TSE ordered Meta and X to provide clarifications about AI usage and allegations of favoritism toward Flávio Bolsonaro on social platforms. Lula's campaign claims unequal treatment in content distribution, moderation, and political content generation. Minister Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva requested detailed technical reports on the platforms' tools.

item.title: Confira a agenda dos presidenciáveis nesta sexta-feira (23)
item.description: Presidential candidates Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) participate in the final televised debate before the runoff at TV Globo, scheduled for 21:20 on Friday night (23). Neither candidate has public engagements during the day and travel to Rio de Janeiro for the debate.

item.title: Nikolas Ferreira usa novamente música de Rubel após retirada de áudio de vídeo
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) reused the song 'Grão de Areia' by Rubel in an Instagram post, following the platform's removal of audio from another video where he discussed the cost of living in northeastern Brazil. The new post features a supporter at a pro-Flávio Bolsonaro rally in Recife, holding a sign praising Nikolas. The controversy sparked mutual accusations involving Rubel, who supports Lula, and Sony Music Brasil, raising issues over copyright rights.
